title: Pre-registration index — strategies frozen before the first tip of the 2026-11-17 .. 2026-11-20 slate
rule: Per the project brief: every strategy's signal, thresholds, universe and exact settlement rule are frozen before the first bet of the slate. Files are hash-chained into data/ledger/ledger.json at publication.
universe: all 30 games on the official 2026-11-17 .. 2026-11-20 slate (data/raw/official_schedule_capture_2026-11-17.json: 2026-11-17=5, 2026-11-18=12, 2026-11-19=4, 2026-11-20=9); source file data/raw/official_schedule_capture_2026-11-17.json; window rule = the newest official schedule capture, today (UTC) + up to 3 days per the project brief
prior_vintage_settled: data/settlement/settlement_2026-11-14.json covers the 2026-11-14 slate of the 2026-11-14..17 vintage; that vintage's 11/15-11/17 picks remain settleable from data/archive/horizon_picks_2026-11-14.json (ledger entry 1).
